svg.aria-label: fatoura-cli: Clean PDF invoices for Tunisian freelancers. Open source · local tool. A terminal CLI and a local web UI. Saves your profile, clients and services once, numbers every invoice, and prints amounts as 13 750,000 DT. Stack: Python, WeasyPrint, Flask. 3 releases, MIT. Opens the fatoura-cli repository on GitHub.
